Read the supplied current case into the factual input ports of the
unchanged legal program. Do not decide the target statutory conclusion. Preserve
who bears a relation TO whom, who files/itemizes, and the actual dates. Explicit
legal givens are usable as givens; never import a listed relation from the statute
into case facts. Each event/record must belong to the current case and carry a
nonempty verbatim facts/question witness. Resolved finite extraction with no
record is [], while unknown/unread is null. Do not invent missing endings or
elections, and do not turn a target claim into proof of its premise. Preserve
unknown itemization when only eligibility is stated. Return only the requested
factual JSON, not a native answer. The code and descriptions specify each port.

{"task": {"current_case": {"source_text": "§7703. Determination of marital status

(a) General rule

    (1) the determination of whether an individual is married shall be made as of the close of his taxable year; except that if his spouse dies during his taxable year such determination shall be made as of the time of such death; and

    (2) an individual legally separated from his spouse under a decree of divorce or of separate maintenance shall not be considered as married.

(b) Certain married individuals living apart

For purposes of those provisions of this title which refer to this subsection, if-

    (1) an individual who is married (within the meaning of subsection (a)) and who files a separate return maintains as his home a household which constitutes for more than one-half of the taxable year the principal place of abode of a child with respect to whom such individual is entitled to a deduction for the taxable year under section 151,

    (2) such individual furnishes over one-half of the cost of maintaining such household during the taxable year, and

    (3) during the last 6 months of the taxable year, such individual's spouse is not a member of such household,

such individual shall not be considered as married.
", "referenced_public_sections": {"151": "§151. Allowance of deductions for personal exemptions

(a) Allowance of deductions

In the case of an individual, the exemptions provided by this section shall be allowed as deductions in computing taxable income.

(b) Taxpayer and spouse

An exemption of the exemption amount for the taxpayer; and an additional exemption of the exemption amount for the spouse of the taxpayer if a joint return is not made by the taxpayer and his spouse, and if the spouse, for the calendar year in which the taxable year of the taxpayer begins, has no gross income and is not the dependent of another taxpayer.

(c) Additional exemption for dependents

An exemption of the exemption amount for each individual who is a dependent (as defined in section 152) of the taxpayer for the taxable year.

(d) Exemption amount

For purposes of this section-

    (1) In general

    Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the term "exemption amount" means $2,000.

    (2) Exemption amount disallowed in case of certain dependents

    In the case of an individual with respect to whom a deduction under this section is allowable to another taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the individual's taxable year begins, the exemption amount applicable to such individual for such individual's taxable year shall be zero.

    (3) Phaseout

        (A) In general

        In the case of any taxpayer whose adjusted gross income for the taxable year exceeds the applicable amount in effect under section 68(b), the exemption amount shall be reduced by the applicable percentage.

        (B) Applicable percentage

        For purposes of subparagraph (A), the term "applicable percentage" means 2 percentage points for each $2,500 (or fraction thereof) by which the taxpayer's adjusted gross income for the taxable year exceeds the applicable amount in effect under section 68(b). In the case of a married individual filing a separate return, the preceding sentence shall be applied by substituting "$1,250" for "$2,500". In no event shall the applicable percentage exceed 100 percent.

    (5) Special rules for taxable years 2018 through 2025

    In the case of a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026, the term "exemption amount" means zero.
"}, "facts": "Alice and Bob got married on April 5th, 2012. Alice and Bob were legally separated under a decree of divorce on September 16th, 2017.", "question": "Section 7703(a)(2) applies to Alice for the year 2018."}, "unchanged_legal_program": {"input_fields_json": "{"query_person":{"type":"string","description":"被查询个人。"},"query_year":{"type":"integer","description":"进行婚姻状态判断的公历纳税年度；判断时点为该年 12 月 31 日。"},"legal_separation_decrees":{"type":"array|null","description":"已解析的有向法令事实；每个对象严格为 {individual:string,spouse:string,decree_type:string,effective_date:string,end_date:string|null,open_ended:boolean}。decree_type 只能是 divorce 或 separate_maintenance；日期为 YYYY-MM-DD，区间包含端点。end_date 为 null 只有在 open_ended 为 true 时才明确持续；否则结束状态未知。null 数组表示未读取或未解析，[] 表示已解析且无记录。"}}", "name": "legal_separation_status", "program": "def apply(inputs,premises):
    person=inputs.get('query_person')
    year=inputs.get('query_year')
    if not isinstance(person,str) or type(year) is not int:
        return {'handled':False,'answer':None}
    close=str(year)+'-12-31'
    calendar_year(close)
    decrees=inputs.get('legal_separation_decrees')
    if decrees is None:
        return {'handled':False,'answer':None}
    if not isinstance(decrees,list):
        raise TypeError('legal_separation_decrees must be an array or null')
    uncertain=False
    for record in decrees:
        if not isinstance(record,dict):
            raise TypeError('Each decree must be an object')
        individual=record.get('individual'); spouse=record.get('spouse'); kind=record.get('decree_type')
        start=record.get('effective_date'); end=record.get('end_date'); opened=record.get('open_ended')
        if not isinstance(individual,str) or not isinstance(spouse,str) or kind not in ('divorce','separate_maintenance') or not isinstance(start,str) or type(opened) is not bool:
            raise ValueError('Malformed legal-separation decree')
        calendar_year(start)
        if end is not None:
            if not isinstance(end,str) or opened:
                raise ValueError('A closed decree interval requires open_ended false')
            calendar_year(end)
            if end<start:
                raise ValueError('Decree interval ends before it begins')
        if individual!=person or start>close:
            continue
        if end is not None and end>=close:
            return {'handled':True,'answer':'Entailment'}
        if end is None and opened:
            return {'handled':True,'answer':'Entailment'}
        if end is None:
            uncertain=True
    if uncertain:
        return {'handled':False,'answer':None}
    return {'handled':True,'answer':'Contradiction'}", "query_clause": "7703(a)(2)", "scope": "exact_clause", "source_quote": "(2) an individual legally separated from his spouse under a decree of divorce or of separate maintenance shall not be considered as married."}}, "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"inputs": {"type": "object", "properties": {"query_person": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "被查询个人。"}, "query_year": {"type": ["integer", "null"], "description": "进行婚姻状态判断的公历纳税年度；判断时点为该年 12 月 31 日。"}, "legal_separation_decrees": {"type": ["array", "null"], "description": "已解析的有向法令事实；每个对象严格为 {individual:string,spouse:string,decree_type:string,effective_date:string,end_date:string|null,open_ended:boolean}。decree_type 只能是 divorce 或 separate_maintenance；日期为 YYYY-MM-DD，区间包含端点。end_date 为 null 只有在 open_ended 为 true 时才明确持续；否则结束状态未知。null 数组表示未读取或未解析，[] 表示已解析且无记录。", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"individual": {"type": "string"}, "spouse": {"type": "string"}, "decree_type": {"type": "string"}, "effective_date": {"type": "string"}, "end_date": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "open_ended": {"type": "boolean"}}, "required": ["individual", "spouse", "decree_type", "effective_date", "end_date", "open_ended"], "additionalProperties": false}}}, "required": ["query_person", "query_year", "legal_separation_decrees"], "additionalProperties": false}, "witnesses": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"field": {"type": "string", "enum": ["facts", "question"]}, "quote": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["field", "quote"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "unresolved": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}}, "required": ["inputs", "witnesses", "unresolved"], "additionalProperties": false}}
